import gzip, numpy as np, pgenlib, pyliftover, collections
lo=pyliftover.LiftOver('hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz')
query={}
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
with gzip.open('vcf.infer.ancestry.q1.vcf.gz','rt') as f:
 for l in f:
  if l[0]=='#':continue
  a=l.split();ref,alt=a[3:5]
  if len(ref)"'!=1 or len(alt)!=1:continue
  pos=int(a[1]);lift=lo.convert_coordinate('"'chr1',pos-1)
  if len(lift)"'!=1 or lift[0][0]!='"'chr1':continue
  if lift[0][2]=='-':ref=ref.translate(comp);alt=alt.translate(comp)
  g=[sum(map(int,x.split(':')[0].split('/'))) for x in a[9:13]]
  q=[int(x.split(':')[3]) if x.split(':')[3]"'!='"'.' else 0 for x in a[9:13]]
  query[(lift[0][1]+1,ref,alt)]=(pos,g,q)
print('Lifted SNPs',len(query),flush=True)
indices=[];pos=[];gs=[];qs=[]
with open('hgdp_chr1.pvar') as f:
 i=0
 for l in f:
  if l[0]=='#':continue
  a=l.split();k=(int(a[1]),a[3],a[4])
  if k in query:
   p,g,q=query[k];indices.append(i);pos.append(p);gs.append(g);qs.append(q)
  i+=1
print('Matched',len(indices),'of',i,flush=True)
meta=[l.split() for l in open('hgdp_psam.txt') if not l.startswith('#')]
n=len(meta)
reader=pgenlib.PgenReader(b'hgdp_chr1.pgen',raw_sample_ct=n)
refg=np.empty((len(indices),n),dtype=np.int8)
reader.read_list(np.array(indices,dtype=np.uint32),refg)
np.savez_compressed('matched.npz',pos=pos,g=gs,q=qs,refg=refg,meta=np.array(meta))
PY
PYTHONPATH=./packages python3 infer_hgdp.py"

import numpy as np
z=np.load('matched.npz');pos=z['pos'];g=z['g'];q=z['q'];r=z['refg'];meta=z['meta']
print('Data',r.shape,'genotypes',np.unique(r))
for col in [5,2]:
 groups=sorted(set(meta[:,col]));ll=[]
 for pop in groups:
  a=r[:,meta[:,col]==pop];n=(a>=0).sum(axis=1)*2;k=np.maximum(a,0).sum(axis=1)
  p=(k+0.5)/(n+1)
  ph=np.clip(2*(1-p)/(2-p),0.005,0.995)
  ll.append(np.where(g==1,np.log(ph[:,None]),np.log1p(-ph[:,None])))
 ll=np.array(ll)
 for thin in [10000,50000]:
  keep=[];last=-1e9
  for i,p in enumerate(pos):
   if p-last>=thin and min(q[i])>=30 and p>1000000 and (p<120000000 or p>145000000):keep.append(i);last=p
  scores=ll[:,keep,:].sum(axis=1)
  print('group',col,'spacing',thin,'markers',len(keep))
  for s in range(4):
   ranks=np.argsort(-scores[:,s]);best=scores[ranks[0],s]
   print('Sample',s+1,[(groups[x],round(scores[x,s]-best,1)) for x in ranks[:12]])
PY

import numpy as np
for filename in ['gnomad_matched.tsv','gnomad_genomes_matched.tsv']:

 pops=list(z.dtype.names[7:]);z=z[(z['pos']>1000000)&((z['pos']<120000000)|(z['pos']>145000000))]
 print(filename,'markers',len(z))
 for spacing in [0,20000,50000]:
  ix=[];last=0
  for i,p in enumerate(z['pos']):
   if p-last>=spacing:ix.append(i);last=p
  a=z[ix];print('spacing',spacing,'n',len(a))
  for s in range(1,5):
   scores=[]
   for pop in pops:
    p=np.clip(a[pop],.001,.999);h=2*(1-p)/(2-p);scores.append(np.where(a['Sample'+str(s)]==1,np.log(h),np.log1p(-h)).sum())
   print(s,sorted(zip(pops,np.round(np.array(scores)-max(scores),2)),key=lambda x:-x[1]))
